payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops check all intervals, using prefix sums for O(1) sum queries and pruning intervals not longer than the current best to find the longest DDoS period.
payload.rationale: The code exhaustively iterates all possible subarrays with a pruning condition (length <= max_len) that acts as a simple bound, aligning with branch-and-bound principles despite a flat loop structure. No recursion, permutations, bitmasks, or graph traversal is present.
